summary: ship Step 13 `branches sync-dev` silently skipped because the main checkout was left bare
description: `bkit branches sync-dev` exits 0 with `devLocal: skipped` when `core.bare=true` blocks the fast-forward, so the step looks green while local `dev` stays behind `origin/dev`. Only the log line 'git refused: fatal: this operation must be run in a work tree' distinguishes it; the gate item 'Local dev synced' would read as satisfied on a pass-exit without reading that line.
remediation: Detect the bare state in `branches sync-dev` (and `repo info`) and exit non-zero with the repair command, instead of folding it into a skipped field with exit 0.
